62633-the-catalpa-expedition.title: The Catalpa Expedition
62633-the-catalpa-expedition.creator: Z. W. Pease
62633-the-catalpa-expedition.description: A book by Z. W. Pease. On an April morning in 1875, the whaleship Catalpa lay at anchor in the harbor at New Bedford, ready for sea. Although the whaling industry was waning on the ebb tide, there were yet over a hundred whaleships sailing out of the port of New Bedford, and the departure seemed to call for no unusual notice.

arxiv-1604-05814.title: Almost All Even Yao-Yao Graphs Are Spanners
arxiv-1604-05814.creator: Jian Li, Wei Zhan, zhanw-13@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-1604-05814.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by Jian Li, Wei Zhan, zhanw-13@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn. It is an open problem whether Yao-Yao graphs 𝖸𝖸 k \mathsf{YY}_{k} (also known as sparse-Yao graphs) are all spanners when the integer parameter k k is large enough. In this paper we show that, for any integer k ≥ 42 k\geq 42 , the Yao-Yao graph 𝖸𝖸 2 ​ k \mathsf{YY}_{2k} is a t k t_{k} -spanner, with stretch factor t k = 6.03 + O ⁡ ( k − 1 ) t_{k}=6.03+O(k^{-1}) when k k tends to infinity.

arxiv-2012-05247.title: Building Tensor Networks for Holographic States
arxiv-2012-05247.creator: Pawel Caputa, ​, Jorrit Kruthoff, ​, Onkar Parrikar
arxiv-2012-05247.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Pawel Caputa, ​, Jorrit Kruthoff, ​, Onkar Parrikar. We discuss a one-parameter family of states in two-dimensional holographic conformal field theories which are constructed via the Euclidean path integral of an effective theory on a family of hyperbolic slices in the dual bulk geometry. The effective theory in question is the CFT flowed under a T ​ T ¯ T\overline{T} deformation, which “folds” the boundary CFT towards the bulk time-reflection symmetric slice.

arxiv-2211-07262.title: Muon-induced background in a next-generation dark matter experiment based on liquid xenon
arxiv-2211-07262.creator: Viktor Pěč, Vitaly A. Kudryavtsev
arxiv-2211-07262.description: Abstract Muon-induced neutrons can lead to potentially irreducible backgrounds in rare event search experiments. We have investigated the implication of laboratory depth on the muon induced background in a future dark matter experiment capable of reaching the so-called neutrino floor.

arxiv-2302-06516.title: Two-point measurement energy statistics from particle scattering
arxiv-2302-06516.creator: Samuel L. Jacob, Gabriel T. Landi, Massimiliano Esposito, Felipe Barra
arxiv-2302-06516.description: Abstract We show that the energy statistics resulting from a two-point measurement of an isolated quantum system subject to a time-dependent driving protocol can be probed by subjecting the same system to a collision with a suitably prepared incoming particle.

arxiv-2405-16052.title: Identifying Extreme Events in the Stock Market: A Topological Data Analysis
arxiv-2405-16052.creator: Anish Rai, Buddha Nath Sharma, Salam Rabindrajit Luwang, Md.Nurujjaman, Sushovan Majhi
arxiv-2405-16052.description: Abstract This paper employs Topological Data Analysis (TDA) to detect extreme events (EEs) in the stock market at a continental level. Previous approaches, which analyzed stock indices separately, could not detect EEs for multiple time series in one go. TDA provides a robust framework for such analysis and identifies the EEs during the crashes for different indices.

arxiv-2506-11222.title: Many-Body Neural Network Wavefunction for a Non-Hermitian Ising Chain
arxiv-2506-11222.creator: Lavoisier Wah, Remmy Zen, Flore K. Kunst
arxiv-2506-11222.description: Abstract Non-Hermitian (NH) quantum systems have emerged as a powerful framework for describing open quantum systems, non-equilibrium dynamics, and engineered quantum optical materials. However, solving the ground-state properties of NH systems is challenging due to the exponential scaling of the Hilbert space, and exotic phenomena such as the emergence of exceptional points.

pmc-11478548.title: Styphnolobium japonicum Fruit and Germinated Soybean Embryo Complex Extract for Postmenopausal-Symptom Relief
pmc-11478548.creator: Jeong-Won Ahn, Hyun-Soo Kim, Kongara Damodar, Hee-Hyun Shin, Kyung-Mi Kim, Jung-Youl Park, Su-Kil Jang, Yeong-Min Yoo, Jae-Chul Jung, Seong-Soo Joo, Elisa Benetti, Valentina Boscaro
pmc-11478548.description: Background/Objectives: Hormonal alterations during menopause result in substantial physiological changes. Although hormone replacement therapy (HRT) is widely used as a treatment strategy for these changes, its use remains controversial due to its associated risks. Plant isoflavones are phytoestrogens that are considered a potential alternative therapy for postmenopausal syndrome.

pmc-11582164.title: Environmental Proteomics Elucidates Phototrophic Biofilm Responses to Ornamental Lighting on Stone-built Heritage
pmc-11582164.creator: Anxo Méndez, Patricia Sanmartín, Sabela Balboa, Alba Trueba-Santiso
pmc-11582164.description: Recent studies are showing that some lights suitable for illuminating the urban fabric (i.e. that do not include the red, green and blue sets of primary colours) may halt biological colonisation on monuments, mainly that caused by phototrophic subaerial biofilms (SABs), which may exacerbate the biodeterioration of substrates.

pmc-11664675.title: Bilateral External Torque CT Reliably Detects Syndesmotic Lesions in an Experimental Cadaveric Study
pmc-11664675.creator: Silvan Beeler, Esteban Ongini, Bettina Hochreiter, Reto Sutter, Arnd Viehoefer, Stephan H Wirth, Anna-Katharina Calek
pmc-11664675.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Category:Sports; TraumaIntroduction/Purpose:If tibiofibular syndesmosis injury is missed, chronic instability may lead to persistent pain and osteoarthritis. So far, no reliable diagnostic method has been available. The primary objectives of this study were to determine whether defined lesions of the syndesmosis can be correlated with specific tibiofibular joint displacements caused by external rotation (ER) torques and to compare its performance with arthroscopy.

pmc-11758165.title: NLRP3 deficiency aggravated DNFB-induced chronic itch by enhancing type 2 immunity IL-4/TSLP-TRPA1 axis in mice
pmc-11758165.creator: Si-Ting Huang, Zuo-Ming Chen, Zhe Peng, Yu Wang, Fan Yang, Yang Tang, Zi Li, Li Wan
pmc-11758165.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe nod-like receptor family pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) has been implicated in various skin diseases. However, its role in mediating 2, 4-dinitrofluorobenzene (DNFB)-induced chronic itch remains unclear.MethodsWidetype (WT) and Nlrp3 deletion (Nlrp3-/- )mice, the expression of transient receptor potential (TRP) ankyrin 1 (TRPA1) inhibitor or recombinant mice interleukin-18 (IL-18) were used to establish and evaluate the severity of DNFB-mediated chronic itch.

pmc-12426162.creator: Zhanerke Bolatova, Marat Kalishev, Karina Nukeshtayeva, Olzhas Zhamantayev, Zhaniya Dauletkaliyeva, Gaukhar Kayupova, Nurbek Yerdessov, Hans Orru
pmc-12426162.description: IntroductionHand hygiene is a fundamental public health measure that plays a crucial role in preventing the spread of infectious diseases, particularly in communal settings such as schools. The COVID-19 pandemic heightened awareness of hygiene practices, emphasizing the need for sustained interventions to ensure long-term adherence and improved health outcomes among students.

pmc-12829325.title: Phthiriasis palpebrarum in a 7-year-old girl: a case report
pmc-12829325.creator: Tingting Cui, Lina Meng
pmc-12829325.description: This case report presents a rare instance of phthiriasis palpebrarum in a 7-year-old female patient. The patient complained of bilateral eyelid pruritus and erythema lasting for 3 weeks. Slit-lamp examination revealed adult lice and nits adhering to the palpebral margins, and microscopic assessment confirmed the diagnosis of Pthirus pubis infestation.

pmc-12864991.title: High-κ samarium oxysulfate dielectric for two-dimensional electronics with enhanced gate coupling
pmc-12864991.creator: Jiashuai Yuan, Chuanyong Jian, Yujia Gong, Qiankun Ju, Qian Cai, Jiahao Kang, Wei Liu
pmc-12864991.description: Layered dielectric materials and their van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures offer high potential for next-generation two-dimensional (2D) electronic devices, but materials that combine a wide bandgap and high dielectric constant are rare. Here, we present the controllable synthesis of quasi-vdW layered samarium oxysulfate (Sm2O2SO4) single crystals via a molten-salt-assisted chemical vapor deposition (CVD) method.

pmc-13067397.title: TFAP2A regulates SGPP2 transcription to promote lipid accumulation and activate the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway to promote malignant progression in lung adenocarcinoma
pmc-13067397.creator: Qingqing Li, Jiangying Li, Cui Zhang, Yuxuan Deng, Bowen Yang, Li Ma, Yuxiang Liu, Chunliang Wang, Linlin Xu, Jinhong Mei
pmc-13067397.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, highlighting the urgent need for additional molecular biomarkers and therapeutic targets. Transcription factor AP-2α (TFAP2A) is highly expressed in LUAD and is associated with poor prognosis. Sphingosine-1-phosphate phosphatae 2 (SGPP2/SPP2) has been implicated in tumor progression in multiple cancer types; however, its functional role in LUAD cells and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.MethodsBioinformatics analysis was conducted to elucidate the expression patterns of SGPP2 and TFAP2A.

pmc-13525792.title: Clinical Outcomes of Rh(D)-Incompatible Allogeneic Haematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Single-Centre Retrospective Case Series with a Narrative Literature Review
pmc-13525792.creator: Miaomiao Liu, Min Lin, Weijia Fu, Ziwei Wang, Lili Xu, Jie Chen, Jianmin Yang, Haihui Gu, Xiong Ni
pmc-13525792.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Rh(D)-negative individuals are relatively rare in the Chinese population, and clinical experience with Rh(D)-incompatible allogeneic haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (allo-HSCT) remains limited. Compared with ABO incompatibility, the immunohaematological consequences of Rh(D) mismatch in allo-HSCT are less well defined. Herein, we report a single-centre retrospective case series of four patients receiving Rh(D)-incompatible allo-HSCT at our institution, including two Rh(D)-negative recipients with Rh(D)-positive donors and two Rh(D)-positive recipients with Rh(D)-negative donors.
